parsed.explanation: Estimate (7) is the sole basis for proving that d is constant, but its derivation is explicitly omitted, so the required all-cases necessity argument is incomplete under the grading rules. Swapping t and y in the squared lower inequality is one short derivation. Alternatively, the stated route using both inequalities works: with h=y-t and q=b-c, the lower inequality bounds q, while for q=-r<0 the upper inequality and r≤c bound r. One added sentence displaying these calculations would establish (7).
